shadows.name: focus-lift
shadows.purpose: Skip-link and rare elevated focus affordances only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary actions: book, confirm arrival, call next, save.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); padding: 8px 10px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form control used across consoles.
components.css: .ds-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-field { border: 1px solid var(--input); background: var(--card); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 10px 12px; font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Queue Card
components.description: Patient appointment card with temporary number and instruction.
components.html:
Temporary #12

Head to the clinic now.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--divider); background: var(--surface-tint); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 16px; } .ds-num { margin: 0; font: 600 1.5rem/1.2 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-go { margin: 12px 0 0; border-radius: 0.4rem; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--warning-muted); color: var(--warning-foreground); font: 500 0.875rem/1.4 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

components.name: Alert
components.css: .ds-alert { margin: 0; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 25%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 8%, transparent); color: var(--destructive); padding: 8px 12px; font: 400 0.875rem/1.4 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; }

components.name: Primary Nav
components.description: Role switcher strip in the app shell.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Primary"><button class="ds-nav-active" type="button">Patient</button><button class="ds-nav-idle" type="button">Reception</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--divider); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--card) 70%, transparent); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 8px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-idle { border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 6px 10px; height: 28px; font: 500 0.8rem/1 Geist Variable, Segoe UI, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-nav-idle { background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-nav-idle:hover { background: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview: ClinicQueue looks like a calm clinical operations tool: cool teal-tinted surfaces, one deep teal for primary actions, and clear status colors for wait/go and errors. Density serves reception and doctor workflows; patient screens stay short and instructional. The system rejects purple SaaS gradients, cream-terracotta editorial kits, and decorative glass.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained palette: teal primary ≤10% of surface; neutrals carry the rest
Single sans family (Geist + Arabic-capable system fallbacks)
Shared cq-* layout primitives across all role consoles
Flat surfaces; depth via tonal wash and 1px dividers, not heavy shadows

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Primary teal is for actions and current selection only — never large decorative fills.

rules.name: The Product Type Rule
rules.body: No display serifs, no fluid hero clamps, no uppercase eyebrows on every section. Uppercase is reserved for tiny status chips only.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No multi-layer card shadows. If it looks like a 2014 material card, remove the shadow.

dos: Do use cq-* primitives from index.css for new screens so patient/reception/doctor/admin stay one vocabulary.
Do keep Arabic RTL and English LTR parity; prefer logical properties (start/end, ps/pe).
Do make queue numbers and wait/go instructions the visual peak of patient views.
Do use semantic status tokens (destructive, warning, info, success) instead of raw Tailwind red-700 / emerald-800.
donts: Don't use purple-on-white / indigo SaaS gradients or “AI tool” marketing chrome.
Don't use warm cream/sand/terracotta editorial defaults as the body background.
Don't use hero-metric templates, identical icon card grids, glassmorphism, or gradient text.
Don't invent a second button or field style per feature folder.
Don't put side-stripe accent borders on cards or alerts.
Don't hard-code stone-200 / emerald-900/10 dividers when border-divider exists.
